title: Townsend Brown and the Nassau Group

tellings.quote: Towns and Brown also spent a ton of time in Nassau. In fact, his biographer Paul Shatskin even coined a term for a secret group that used to meet there. It was called the Nassau Group

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Townsend Brown, a man whose life is told in a biography called The Man Who Mastered Gravity, spent a great deal of time in Nassau, the capital of the Bahamas. According to Michels, Brown's biographer Paul Schatzkin even coined a name, the Nassau Group, for a secret group that used to meet there, with figures like Eldridge Reeves Johnson and William Stephenson mentioned alongside it. If true, it would point to a private circle working quietly on Brown's ideas away from public view.
